g.text: Hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT to enter ROM USB download mode.

g.desc: Hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT to enter ROM USB download mode.

g.text: H1.1 = 3V3 OUTPUT; H2.1 = fused USB VBUS OUTPUT. Power the board via USB-C.

g.desc: H1.1 = 3V3 OUTPUT; H2.1 = fused USB VBUS OUTPUT. Power the board via USB-C.

g.text: Do not drive H2.1 from another supply: the fuse does not block backfeed into USB.

g.desc: Do not drive H2.1 from another supply: the fuse does not block backfeed into USB.

g.text: USB supply: use a data-capable source/cable with adequate current.

g.desc: USB supply: use a data-capable source/cable with adequate current.

g.text: 4-layer: F.Cu signal / In1 continuous GND / In2 power+signal / B.Cu signal+GND.

g.desc: 4-layer: F.Cu signal / In1 continuous GND / In2 power+signal / B.Cu signal+GND.

g.text: GPIO0/3/45/46 are boot straps. Keep GPIO45/46 LOW during reset.

g.desc: GPIO0/3/45/46 are boot straps. Keep GPIO45/46 LOW during reset.

g.text: H2.5 / H2.6 / H2.20: NC (USB D-/D+ and VBAT are not exposed).

g.desc: H2.5 / H2.6 / H2.20: NC (USB D-/D+ and VBAT are not exposed).

g.text: USB: 90 ohm nominal; JLC04161H-7628 stackup, 0.28 mm width / 0.20 mm gap.

g.desc: USB: 90 ohm nominal; JLC04161H-7628 stackup, 0.28 mm width / 0.20 mm gap.

g.text: 50 C budget: 3V3 500 mA total incl. MCU + VBUS shield 100 mA. Verify prototype thermals / USB TDR.

g.desc: 50 C budget: 3V3 500 mA total incl. MCU + VBUS shield 100 mA. Verify prototype thermals / USB TDR.

g.text: GPIO35/36/37: reserved for octal PSRAM; no external connection.

g.desc: GPIO35/36/37: reserved for octal PSRAM; no external connection.
